items.title: Netanyahu says some Lebanese Christian villages 'asked to be annexed' by Israel
items.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisted on Sunday that some Christian villages in southern Lebanon have asked for Israel's protection from Hezbollah militants.
